acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
Data-dependent acquisition was used in positive ion mode.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: The samples were alkylated by the addition of 100 µL 10 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) in 50 mM ABC with incubation at room temperature in the dark for 20 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The samples were alkylated by the addition of 100 µL 10 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) in 50 mM ABC with incubation at room temperature in the dark for 20 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The gels were resuspended in 100 µL of 50 mM ABC containing 500 ng of digestion-grade trypsin (Promega, V5111), and incubated at 37 °C for 16 h.

labeling.evidence: Protein quantification was performed using the LFQ algorithm and 7 min window for match between runs in MaxQuant software.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: The desalted lyophilized peptides were dissolved in a loading buffer (2% ACN, 0.2% trifluoroacetic acid) and subjected to LC-MS/MS. The data acquisition was performed on a Thermo Scientific Q Exactive Plus equipped with a Waters nanoAcquity UPLC system utilizing a binary solvent system (A: 100% water, 0.1% formic acid; B: 100% ACN, 0.1% formic acid).
